query: When is the chequered flag shown?
note: the clause says end-of-session signal but also names the chequered flag, so this is a near-literal control, not a vocabulary gap

query: Can a driver celebrate on the way back to the pits after winning?
note: the clause says act of celebration before reaching parc ferme

query: Can a car that broke down on its way to the grid before the start still start from the grid?
note: the clause says reconnaissance lap and under its own power; the formation lap clauses are a different event

query: Are dogs allowed in the paddock?
Who may touch a car that has stopped on the circuit?
note: the clause says no one except the driver, with named places where it is allowed; B1.5.2 (marshals remove a stopped car) is a supporting clause and not gold; topic overlaps frozen Q12 but the clause is different

query: Is a car still running in the session if the driver climbs out and walks away?
note: the clause says abandoned and withdrawn from the session

query: What must a driver do with the car when retiring on the circuit?
note: the clause says abandons, neutral or clutch disengaged, ERS shut down, steering wheel in place

query: Is a practice start allowed on the warm-up lap before the race?
note: the clause says formation lap and practice starts forbidden

query: Can officials make a team use different tyres from the ones it was given?
note: the clause says the Technical Delegate may select alternative tyres

query: Can a team swap a brand new tyre for another new one?
note: the clause says present both tyres to the Technical Delegate

query: Are wet-weather tyres compulsory when the formation lap is run behind the Safety Car?
note: B6.3.7 applies when B5.10.1a or B5.15.2a applies; B5.10.1 is a supporting clause and not gold

query: When can intermediate or wet tyres be used in practice?
note: after the Race Director declares the track wet

query: Who has to attend the podium and the press conference?
note: first three finishers and a representative of the winning constructor

query: Must teams give a young driver a run in practice?
note: the clause says a driver with no more than two Championship Races, in FP1 or FP2 at two Competitions

query: Who may stand on the pit wall at the start of the race?
note: pit wall kept free of all persons except permitted team members, officials and fire marshals

query: Can a car be stopped and inspected after a crash?
note: the clause says the Race Director may require a car involved in an accident be stopped and checked

query: Can teams cool the car on the grid with a fan running on petrol?
note: the clause says forced air equipment must be powered only by electricity

query: What happens to a car that is too damaged to get back to the pits?
note: the clause says leave the track as soon as it is safe, at the Race Director's discretion
